Walls = 126.3 sq ft · Ground coverage = 36.7% of plot

Louvred glass ventilator, exhaust fan provision
1. Do not scale the drawing; follow written dimensions. Room sizes are clear inside sizes (wall face to
2. Structure: load-bearing masonry, brick in cement mortar 1:6. External walls 11" (280 mm) to carry
the first floor; internal walls 9" (230 mm). Outer face of the building is unchanged; the extra 2"
3. Padavi is open (no walls). Its RCC slab is carried by 6 RCC pillars 9" x 9": 4 along the front
(6'-4" clear bays) and 2 at the back corners against the house front wall, with RCC beams along the
front and both sides. Pillar, beam and footing sizes to be confirmed by the structural engineer.
4. Provide RCC plinth band and RCC lintel band (6" deep) over all walls; door/window tops at lintel
5. Assumed levels, confirm with engineer: plinth +1'-6" above road, floor-to-floor 10'-0", lintel
6. Bathroom and toilet: sunken slab 1'-0", waterproofing 1'-0" up the walls (3'-0" in shower), floor
7. Staircase in Padavi: dog-legged, 3'-0" wide flights, 17 risers of about 7", treads 10", landing
3'-0" x 6'-0"; MS handrail 3'-0" high and railing on the open north side.
8. Kitchen: L-shaped platform 2'-0" deep at 2'-8" height, along the hall-side wall from O2 and up the
left wall past W2, sink under W2; provide chimney/exhaust opening on the left wall.
9. Toilet has two WCs: Indian pan (IWC) on the rear wall and wall-hung western WC (EWC) with concealed
cistern on the right wall, giving about 1'-8" clear in front. Provide health faucets for both.
10. Passage in front of bathroom/toilet is 2'-10½" clear. Electrical, plumbing and structural drawings
11. Bedroom: queen bed 5'-0" x 6'-6" with headboard on the front wall, centred (1'-9½" each side for
side tables); wardrobe 4'-0" x 1'-6" deep, full height 7'-0", in the rear-right corner clear of the
12. Windows are centred on their rooms. Doors D1, D2 and opening O2 sit flush against the central
13. Windows W1/W2 face 1'-0" to 3'-0" side gaps; confirm neighbour clearance before fixing.
